changeSet.comment: Lets a GiST index combine scalar equality (car_id) with range overlap (period).
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist

changeSet.author: car-reservation
changeSet.comment: Generated range column, CHECKs and the no-overlap exclusion constraint. No Liquibase Community change types exist for these (addCheckConstraint is a paid change type).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE reservation ADD COLUMN period tstzrange GENERATED ALWAYS AS (tstzrange(start_time, end_time, '[)')) STORED; ALTER TABLE reservation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_reservation_status CHECK (status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')); -- timestamptz subtraction is absolute elapsed time, so this is exact and DST-independent ALTER TABLE reservation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_reservation_duration CHECK (end_time - start_time BETWEEN interval '2 hours' AND interval '24 hours'); -- the double-booking guarantee: no two CONFIRMED reservations of one car may overlap ALTER TABLE reservation ADD CONSTRAINT ex_reservation_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (car_id WITH =, period WITH &&) WHERE (status = 'CONFIRMED');
